$description: Earshot design tokens (DTCG 2025.10): the light and dark themes plus the shared tokens. Built by @earshot/tokens from packages/tokens/tokens. Don't edit.

bg-subtle.$description: Subtle background: sidebars, table stripes, code blocks.

border-strong.$description: Input borders and other component edges. At least 3:1 on bg.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text. At least 4.5:1 on bg, surface, and surface-raised.

accent.$description: Primary actions: ink on paper in light, paper on ink in dark.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent. At least 4.5:1.

focus-ring.$description: Focus rings. At least 3:1 on bg.

state-proposed-text.$description: Proposed (blue): text on its soft background, at least 4.5:1.

state-proposed-solid.$description: Proposed (blue): solid fill for dots, icons, and strong pills, at least 3:1 on bg.

state-conflict-text.$description: Conflict (amber): text on its soft background, at least 4.5:1.

state-conflict-solid.$description: Conflict (amber): solid fill for dots, icons, and strong pills, at least 3:1 on bg.

state-synced-text.$description: Synced (green): text on its soft background, at least 4.5:1.

state-synced-solid.$description: Synced (green): solid fill for dots, icons, and strong pills, at least 3:1 on bg.

state-failed-text.$description: Failed (red): text on its soft background, at least 4.5:1.

state-failed-solid.$description: Failed (red): solid fill for dots, icons, and strong pills, at least 3:1 on bg.

accent.$description: shadcn's subtle hover fill (neutral step 4), not the brand color. That's --primary.
